protocol.bootstrap_grouping: provider plus annual target-start year; all industries in a year stay together
protocol.selection_rule: All eight disjoint published leaf industries; NZ never enters training or development.

source.attribution: This work is based on/includes Stats NZ's data which are licensed by Stats NZ for reuse under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence.
source.limitations: National administrative card-spend aggregates share economic shocks. Cash, cheques, bank transfers and other non-card sales are outside scope. The June 2025 release revised/backcast classifications using previously unclassified transactions. This current revised vintage is retrospective unseen-provider evidence, not a vintage-correct prospective test, borrower revenue, expenses, repayment or default labels.
source.measure: Nominal monthly merchant electronic-card spending, a partial revenue proxy
source.published_status_policy: F final, P provisional, R revised accepted when numeric and unsuppressed; C confidential/missing and all blanks remain null, never zero.
source.taxonomy_policy: Eight disjoint ANZSIC06 merchant leaf groups. Core retail, retail and total parent aggregates excluded; quarterly and annual rows, counts, percentages, adjusted and trend rows excluded.
source.title: Electronic card transactions: August 2026; monthly actual values by industry group
source.units: million NZD, current prices, GST inclusive, not seasonally adjusted
